name: Hotel Pinecrest Heritage
tagline: Colonial Elegance Surrounded by Whispering Woods
description: Nestled in the tranquil hills of invented Pinevalley, Hotel Pinecrest Heritage delivers timeless architecture, warm hill-station hospitality, and serene valley panoramas. Built with handcrafted stone and cedar woodwork, this retreat offers peaceful forest strolls, wholesome farm-to-table cuisine, and modern conveniences for travelers seeking rejuvenating getaways.

rooms.name: Heritage Classic Room
rooms.description: Charming colonial-style guest room with polished timber flooring, warm lighting, and garden views.

rooms.name: Valley View Deluxe
rooms.description: Spacious premium room opening into a private balcony that captures dramatic morning sunrises over the cedar valley.

rooms.name: The Viceroy Suite
rooms.description: Luxurious two-room master suite featuring antique furniture, dedicated lounge area, and panoramic mountain vistas.

gallery.alt: Front elevation of Hotel Pinecrest Heritage under twilight
Evening bonfire set amidst pine trees
Cozy hearth and armchairs in the guest lounge

houseRules: Government approved photo ID required for every adult guest
Quiet hours observed between 10:30 PM and 07:00 AM
Smoking strictly prohibited within interior rooms and corridors
Outside alcohol is not allowed in public lounge areas

faqs.question: Is vehicle parking available at the property?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary private parking is available on premises for resident guests.

faqs.question: Can extra beds or cribs be accommodated?
faqs.answer: Rollaway beds and cribs can be accommodated in Deluxe Rooms and the Viceroy Suite upon request.

faqs.question: Are rooms heated during winter?
faqs.answer: All rooms feature modern radiator heating systems and electric blankets during colder months.

reviews.author: Ananya Sen
reviews.text: The vintage architecture and cedar wood fragrance make this place enchanting. Breakfast on the veranda was unforgettable.

reviews.author: Vikramaditya Roy
reviews.text: Peaceful ambience, warm staff, and very well-maintained heritage rooms. Ideal getaway away from crowded hill stations.
